messages:
support_tina: Hey team — Customer `acme-corp` reporting lots of dashboard tiles stuck on loading, multiple 500/504s from analytics API. Users see empty panels since ~08:12 UTC. Can someone take a look?
eng_oncall_mike: On it. Any request ids or sample times? Which dashboard?
support_tina: Sent customer repro: main ops dashboard (last 24h) — they clicked refresh and got spinning tiles. From the browser console: `analytics.internal/api/query -> 504 (gateway timeout)` and one `500 (internal)` earlier. Sample correlation id: `cid-9f4a2b`.
eng_oncall_mike: Thanks. Checking logs now. pinging @sre_rahul in case it's infra related.
sre_rahul: Seeing a spike in fanout latency from the analytics-proxy around 08:10-08:15. A bunch of downstream ClickHouse shards are returning slow. Looks like query fanout times out after 10s, then proxy returns 504.
support_tina: Repro steps I gave customer: 1) Login console 2) Open "Ops Overview" dashboard 3) Set range to last 24h 4) Click Refresh. They attached HAR and trace.
eng_oncall_mike: Can you paste the short log snippet for `cid-9f4a2b`?
support_tina: Sure — from analytics-proxy logs:
```
[08:12:03] INFO request cid=9f4a2b route=/api/query payload={panel_id:42} 
[08:12:13] WARN shard=ch-03 query_timeout elapsed=10s 
[08:12:13] ERROR cid=9f4a2b upstream=clickhouse status=504 message="timeout"
[08:12:13] ERROR cid=9f4a2b response=504 return_code=UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT
```
product_emma: Customer is seeing this in Prod. Any ETA on fix or workaround? They asked if it's related to last rollout.
sre_rahul: I see a recent config tweak that lowered clickhouse query timeout from 15s -> 10s merged earlier today (PR #485). Could be the culprit for heavier fanout queries. Rolling back that config should reduce 504s.
eng_oncall_mike: I'll roll back the timeout change on the proxy and re-deploy a hotfix config. Deploy-bot, start rollback for analytics-proxy config.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started rollback for config: analytics-proxy@canary -> analytics-proxy@stable (initiated by eng_oncall_mike).
support_tina: Created support ticket INC-12345 and notified customer. Told them we're investigating and will follow up in 30m.
eng_oncall_mike: Rollback started, will monitor metrics. If successful we'll confirm with customer. Also adding a short-term mitigation: increase proxy parallelism and enable query sampling to avoid heavy fanout.
sre_rahul: After rollback metrics look better — error rate dropped from 6% -> 0.5% over the last 3 minutes. Still watching.
product_emma: Thanks. Please add postmortem if config change caused customer impact and link to PR. Also notify Billing/CS if this affected SLAs.
support_tina: Will update ticket and close once customer confirms panels load fine.
eng_oncall_mike: Closing loop: continue monitoring 30m, then move change to staging/regression test to catch heavy fanout queries. :thumbsup:
